description: Check up to 25 names across up to 4 TLDs (100 combinations) in one call: per-domain status (available, taken, likely available or unknown), registrar, creation and expiry from each registry's RDAP server, with DNS fallback. Use to scan a naming shortlist or brand portfolio in one request instead of dozens. Availability is not a price quote: premium and reserved names exist, and an unreachable registry reads unknown, never available. Example: names=acme,acmehq. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

names.description: Comma-separated names or full domains, 1 to 25 (e.g. acme,acmehq)
